item.title: I rebooted my social life
item.description:
📝 But what made living like this difficult was that my social life had also ground to a halt. It turns out that when you don’t have them, you start to miss connections with other humans. And this was when I finally realised something that should have been obvious.
🔗 Read more: https://takes.jamesomalley.co.uk/p/this-might-be-oversharing

item.title: Meta made scam ads harder to find instead of removing them
item.description:
📝 “So successful was the search-result cleanup that Meta, the documents show, added the tactic to a ‘general global playbook’ it has deployed against regulatory scrutiny in other markets, including the United States, Europe, India, Australia, Brazil and Thailand,” Reuters wrote. Previous Reuters reporting found Meta internally projected that about 10% of its 2024 revenue would come from ads tied to scams and banned goods, though the company later said that estimate was overly broad. Reuters also reported the rate was double in China.
🔗 Read more: https://sherwood.news/tech/rather-than-fully-cracking-down-on-scam-ads-meta-worked-to-make-them-harder/
